description: This Java class defines a dialog window for creating Android Virtual Devices (AVDs) within an IDE environment, providing UI components and logic for setting up AVD parameters such as target, skin, SD card options, and system image.

classes.name: CreateAvdDialog
classes.description: A dialog class for creating and configuring Android Virtual Devices (AVDs) within an IDE, handling user input and AVD creation logic.

methods.name: initializeDisplaySizes
methods.description: Initializes a static map of display sizes for different skins.

methods.name: generateAvdName
methods.description: Generates a unique default name for a new AVD.

methods.name: getSkinInfo
methods.description: Returns display size and orientation info for a given skin name.

methods.name: containsDefaultSkinWithSuffix
methods.description: Checks if skins array contains default skin with suffix.

methods.name: getSkinPresentation
methods.description: Returns a formatted string for skin display including size info.

methods.name: reloadAbiCombo
methods.description: Reloads system images (ABIs) based on selected target.

methods.name: getSystemImages
methods.description: Retrieves system images for a given Android target.

methods.name: updateSpinner
methods.description: Updates the SD card size spinner limits based on selected units.

methods.name: updateSdCardElements
methods.description: Enables or disables SD card input fields based on user selection.

methods.name: doOKAction
methods.description: Handles the OK button action, validating input and creating the AVD.

methods.name: getSdCardParameter
methods.description: Returns the SD card configuration string based on user input.
